title: Membrane Phase, Charge, and Curvature Regulate alpha-Synuclein Binding Dynamics.
authors: Kou, Orianna H; Sakurai, Cailyn M; Ramirez, Stephanie Y; Kim, Brian H; Johnson, David H; Zhang, Zixin; Lee, Christopher T; Zeno, Wade F
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验与粗粒化模拟，系统研究了膜相、电荷和曲率如何协同调控α-突触核蛋白（无序蛋白）与膜的动态结合，涉及无序蛋白、蛋白-膜互作及计算方法，核心命中。
